name: Blast of Flame
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 4, magus 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area cone-shaped burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You unleash a blast of flame in the area. Each creature in the area takes 1d6 fire damage per caster level (maximum 10d6). A successful saving throw halves this damage.

Flammable materials burn if the flames touch them. A character can extinguish burning items as a full-round action.
